meta.name: CCNL Sistemazioni Idraulico-Forestali e Idraulico-Agraria (Operai OTI)
meta.sector: sistemazioni idraulico-forestali e idraulico-agrarie — operai a tempo indeterminato

family.reason: Hydraulic and forestry works, manual workers.

sources.title: Tabella retributiva operai OTI CCNL A181 rinnovo 04/12/2025. Tranches 01/01/2026, 01/01/2027, 01/01/2028. Conglobato. Parametri Art. 49 CCNL 2021: L1=100, L2=108, L3=111, L4=116, L5=123.

CCNL previgente 2021: Art. 49 parametri operai, Art. 7 apprendistato sotto-inquadramento, Art. 52 modello conglobato div=169. Structural rules carried forward to 2025 rinnovo (2025 PDF image-only; full text unavailable).

notes.text: CCNL A181 — Sistemazioni Idraulico-Forestali (Operai OTI). Split from impiegati contract: salary bands overlap, requiring separate files for correct engine ordering and under-classification apprenticeship. 5 livelli operai (O1-O5). Conglobato. Divisore 169, 14 mensilita.
Seniority operai: nessuno scatto di anzianita previsto a livello CCNL nazionale. Gli scatti sono disciplinati dai CIRL (contratti integrativi regionali). Modellati con importo zero e maximum_count=0.

limitation.remediation: Add the CIRL regional scatti outside the engine and record the limitation (as ert_veneto / provincial_third_elements).

notes.text: Serie retributiva starts 01/01/2026 (first tranche with primary-source data). Retroactive 2025 tabella not available in machine-readable form; pre-2026 amounts omitted.
Apprendistato: livelli O1 e O2 esclusi da destination_levels (engine requires at least 2 levels below minimum; O2 at order=2 cannot go 2 below). Only O3, O4, O5 supported.
Structural rules (Art. 7, 49, 52) taken from 2021 previgente CCNL text. The 2025 rinnovo PDF is image-only and full text is unavailable for independent verification.

limitation.remediation: Verify the structural rules against the 2025 renewal text.

notes.text: Apprendistato durate: la tabella Art. 7 elenca livelli 2-6 (scala impiegati). Le durate sono mappate su O3/O4/O5 per corrispondenza di livello; la ripartizione per categoria non e confermata dal testo.

limitation.remediation: Confirm the Art. 7 durations for the operai categories and fix the tracks, or record the limitation.

notes.text: OVERTIME/LEAVE/ABSENCE (L3): Art. 50 CCNL 2023 — straordinario diurno 24%, notturno straordinario 38%, festivo straordinario 50%. Ferie 22 giorni (orario su 5 giorni, Art. 12). Malattia: trattamento INPS; nessuna integrazione datoriale a livello CCNL nazionale (Art. 60). Assenza: divisore 26. Rates from 2023 CCNL PDF; 2025 rinnovo structural rules assumed unchanged (text image-only).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: APPRENTICE INPS RATES: the apprentice rates of the sector (agricoltura) apply the 10% of L. 296/2006 art. 1 c. 773 plus the 1.61% NASpI, but no source found settles the disoccupazione and CISOA contributions of agricultural apprentices (INPS circ. 43/2026 gives no apprentice rates). The contributions of an apprentice may differ.

limitation.remediation: Source the apprentice rates of agricoltura (an INPS circular or an association table of 2026), mark the apprentice block of contribution/2026/agricoltura.json derived, then remove this note.

reviews.scope: The accrual rule of the tredicesima (fractions of a month) against the full CCNL text.
findings: Art. 14 - Mensilità aggiuntive (13ª e 14ª) (p. 43): "dette mensilità aggiuntive sono frazionabili in dodicesimi nell’ipotesi di inizio o di cessazione del rapporto nel corso dell’anno. [...] La frazione di mese superiore a 15 giorni viene considerata come un mese intero.". Added: more_than 15 (the file applied the engine default, at least 15 days).

reviews.scope: Minimum pay of the operai forestali con rapporto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato from 1 January 2026, 2027 and 2028 against the tables of the signed 2025 renewal (Allegati B, C, C1, scanned pages read as images). AI review only.
findings: The 2026-2028 minimums now cite the TOTALE NAZIONALE CONGLOBATO of the signed tables (pp. 29-31) instead of a secondary site and the Art. 35 parameters.
Level 3 in 2027 and 2028 was 1 cent below the table (1.507,53 and 1.528,09) and level 4 in 2026 1 cent above (1.537,90).
